name: anylawyer
description: Research legislation, case law, regulator decisions, procurement materials, and legal registers from authoritative Polish, Central European, and EU sources. AnyLawyer returns source identifiers, citations, official links, and bounded excerpts when available.

interface.longDescription:
Research legislation, case law, regulator decisions, procurement materials, and legal registers from authoritative Polish, Central European, and EU sources. AnyLawyer returns source identifiers, citations, official links, and bounded excerpts when available.

Sources include Polish, Czech, Hungarian, and Slovak legislation; indexed EU regulations and directives with CELEX and EUR-Lex citations; Polish Supreme Court, common-court, administrative-court, Constitutional Tribunal, and procurement-appeal rulings; UOKiK, UODO, and KNF materials; Polish tax and labour-inspector interpretations; procurement notices; and current or full KRS company-register extracts.

All tools are read-only. AnyLawyer does not create, change, file, or delete records in any register. Results are research material, not legal advice. Sign-in with an AnyLawyer account is required.
defaultPrompt: Quote GDPR article 32 with its EUR-Lex citation.
Find Polish Supreme Court rulings on non-compete compensation.
Get the current KRS record for 0000123456.

positive.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to quote GDPR article 32 (security of processing) and give its official EUR-Lex citation.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anylawyer_get_eu_law_article with regulation GDPR and article_number 32. Returns the verbatim text of Article 32 "Security of processing" and cites CELEX 02016R0679-20160504 with its EUR-Lex link.

positive.description: Find, then read, an EU-law provision
positive.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to find the GPSR provision that lists the information an online product offer must show, then quote that article.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anylawyer_search_eu_law filtered to GPSR, identifies Article 19 (obligations of economic operators in the case of distance sales), then calls anylawyer_get_eu_law_article for GPSR article 19 and quotes the required offer information (manufacturer name and contact details, product identification, warnings and safety information) with the CELEX 02023R0988 citation.

positive.description: Look up a Polish company-register record
positive.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to get the current KRS record for KRS number 0000123456 in the register of entrepreneurs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anylawyer_get_current_krs_record with krs 0000123456 and rejestr P (not the full historical record). Reports the entity as RODENSTOCK POLSKA SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ, a limited liability company with its seat in Warsaw, using the official register data.

positive.description: Search Polish Supreme Court case law with an English prompt
positive.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to find Polish Supreme Court rulings about compensation for a non-compete agreement after employment ends.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anylawyer_search_supreme_court_rulings with a Polish query (for example "zakaz konkurencji po ustaniu stosunku pracy odszkodowanie"). Lists rulings from the Labour and Social Insurance Chamber with their case signatures (for example III PZP 2/15) and sn.pl links, summarised in English.

positive.description: Search the UOKiK register of prohibited consumer clauses
positive.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to find clauses in the UOKiK register of prohibited consumer-contract terms about automatic renewal of a fixed-term contract.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anylawyer_search_prohibited_contract_clauses with a Polish query such as "przedłużenie umowy". Returns register entries such as clause 634 (case XVII Amc 23/05, internet services) on extending a fixed-term contract unless the consumer objects within a very short period, with the rejestr.uokik.gov.pl link.

negative.description: Request to change a public register. AnyLawyer is read-only: ChatGPT should explain that it cannot change the KRS entry or file anything with the court. It may read the current record to show the registered address, but no write action exists or is attempted.
negative.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to change the registered address in KRS record 0000123456 and file the update with the court.

negative.description: Request to delete an official decision. AnyLawyer only reads public registers: ChatGPT should explain that it cannot delete or alter UOKiK records. It may look the decision up, but no write action exists or is attempted.
negative.prompt: Use AnyLawyer to delete UOKiK decision RPZ-15/2019 from the official register.

negative.description: Request unrelated to legal sources. AnyLawyer has no booking capability: ChatGPT should not call any AnyLawyer tool.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at a restaurant in Warsaw tonight.

review.commerce_description: AnyLawyer does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Fixes the reviewed test cases. Legislation research now answers within one tool call instead of running past client time limits; Polish-language collections are searched with Polish terms when the user writes in English; common-court search ranks by relevance; KRS extracts name the entity correctly; oversized results stay structured. Test cases now cover the fast, deterministic tools.
